dynamic_line.yes: I lived alone, on the old family property way out in the middle of nowhere.  My husband passed away a bit over a month before this started… cancer.  If anything good has come out of all this, it's that I finally see a positive to losing him so young.  I'd been shut in for a while anyway.  When I heard about foreign weapons and sleeper agents, and rioting and such, I curled up with my woods soup and tried not to worry.
